exposure: Preconception fertility status (spontaneous conception vs. IVF-ICSI)
cohort: 330 women aged 40 years and older and 450 women aged 30 to 34 years who delivered a singleton
finding: In women aged 40 years and older, preconception IVF-ICSI was associated with a higher incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension and operative delivery (including emergency cesarean section and instrumental delivery) compared to spontaneous conception.
mod_finding: Operative delivery rates were higher in the IVF-ICSI group compared to the spontaneous conception group.
